name: catalog-entity-single-plan-read
goal: One CatalogService.entity request reads the complete planning snapshot once, with the same detail, errors and freshness

evidence: CatalogService.entity read planning.plans(revision) twice: in held and again in catalogDetail. Expected one complete planning read per request, same detail, errors and per-request freshness. Reproduced in packages/desktop/test/catalog-entity-reads.test.ts on unchanged 17a1225 source.

cd packages/desktop && bunx vitest run test/catalog-entity-reads.test.ts on unchanged 17a1225 source, test sha256 9ff79251506357956612665271712cef699c8824fb336e1297a24d885cb4eddd: 2 failed, 1 passed. expect(reads.mock.calls) received 4 calls for 2 requests and 6 for 3; all detail and freshness assertions before it passed; error case passed with one read each.
CatalogService.held returns its plans; entity passes the plan of the id to catalogDetail, which no longer calls planning.plans. No cache kept between requests; revision resolution untouched.

Same unchanged test (sha256 9ff79251...) passes 3/3 on final source. Guard: 17a CatalogService and catalogDetail swapped in by vitest resolveId fail with 4 vs 2 and 6 vs 3 reads; restored 3/3.
